origin.says: 雨 (rain) for the meaning plus 妾 (concubine) as the sound: a brief shower, so a fleeting moment.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 夌 (to climb over) as the sound: a squared timber, hence the edge or corner where its faces meet.

扼.def: to clutch, to grasp; to choke, to strangle

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 厄 (distress, a yoke) as the sound: to grip with the hand, to choke.

扼.name: throttle

origin.says: 莫 (do not) was the original drawing of sunset; once it was used for 'do not', an extra 日 (sun) was added below to keep the meaning dusk.

ety.hint: Cloth 衤 that restricts 禁; 禁 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 禁 (forbid) as the sound: the front fold of a garment, the lapel.

谄.def: to flatter, to cajole; toady, yes-man

锲.def: sickle; to cut, to carve, to engrave

ety.hint: Something engraved 契 in metal 钅; 契 also provides the pronunciation
A person 彐冖又 lying down on a bed 丬 in their home 宀

origin.says: 宀 (roof) and 爿 (bed) for the meaning, with 𠬶 (hand with broom) as the sound: lying down to sleep at home. Simplified from 寢, with the bed shortened.

锄.def: hoe; to eradicate, to weed out

ety.hint: A metal 钅 tool 助; 助 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 助 (help) as the sound: a hoe. Simplified from 鋤.

锄.name: hoe

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 予 (give) as the sound: to draw out, to pour out one's feelings.
文 (writing) as the sound plus 糸 (silk) for the meaning: threads in a tangle, disorder.

眷.def: to take an interest in; to care for

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 龹 (rolling hands) as the sound: to look back fondly, to care for; also one's family.

眷.name: fond gaze

跋.def: to walk, to travel; epilogue, colophon

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 犮 as the sound: to trek over land, and by extension an afterword at the end of a book.

跋.name: trek

ety.hint: A bald 秃 head 页; 秃 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 秃 (bald) beside 页 (head): a bald head, hence worn down, decayed, dispirited. Simplified from 頹 (頁 → 页).
Two 克 (bear a load) side by side: people carrying heavy loads, careful and wary. The word may be a variant of 驚 (alarmed); the build is not well attested.
羽 (wings) for the meaning plus 扁 (flat) as the sound: to fly lightly, to flutter.

ety.hint: As trustworthy 㐰 as spring-water 川
Extravagant 夸 silk 纟 clothes; 夸 also provides the pronunciation

辄.def: often, readily; scattered; the weapon-rack of a chariot

origin.says: A drawing of a spoon or ladle; later also a dagger. Not to be confused with the look-alike shapes in 老 (old), 比 (compare) and 真 (true), which come from other drawings.

匕.name: dagger
匕.in: 能些此比它化北指死呢批花背毕华货疑混剩皆嘴乘屁谐熊泥蛇葬旨凝紫庇匙尼妮柴脂棍昆燕毙乖颖哗雌讹驼桦鸵舵揩靴楷稽冀

origin.says: A variant of 刀 (knife) with its stroke turned, used for the word 'sly, cunning'.

巳.def: the hours from 9 to 11; 6th terrestrial branch

origin.says: A drawing, one reading of a fetus (as in 包 (wrap)), another of a snake. Used as the sixth earthly branch (the snake).

巳.name: snake branch
巳.in: 导包港跑异抱胞泡撰饱炮巷刨鲍袍雹祀苞熙

ety.hint: A knife 刀 sharp enough to draw blood 丶

origin.says: 刀 (knife) with an extra mark on the blade pointing to its sharp edge: the cutting edge.

ety.hint: Picture of an open 一 mouth 口

origin.says: 口 (mouth) with a stroke inside for words or breath coming out: to say.
An old drawing whose object is disputed: one reading a carrying pole (the first form of 任 (to bear)), another a weaving spool, another an axe. Used as the ninth heavenly stem.

亢.def: high, proud; violent, excessive; skilled; surname

origin.says: Drawn as a person with a line across the legs; the original meaning is unclear. Used for high, proud, excessive.

亢.name: high

ety.hint: A cover-cloth 冖 on a table 几

origin.says: Originally 宀 (roof) over 儿 (person): a person idle at home with nothing to do, hence superfluous. The roof lost its dot and the person turned into the shape 几 (small table).

ety.hint: Ten 十 different types of grass 艹

origin.says: Originally three sprouts 屮 (sprout) together: many plants, grasses. The sprouts are now written like 十 (ten) over 廾 (two hands).

夯.def: burden, load; to lift up; to tamp down

ety.hint: A load that takes great 大 strength 力

origin.says: 大 (big) above 力 (strength): it takes great strength to lift the heavy rammer, hence to tamp down earth, or a heavy load.

夯.name: rammer

origin.says: A picture of a broad axe on a long handle, related to 戈 (halberd); borrowed for the fifth heavenly stem.

轧.def: to crush, to grind; mill, roller

origin.says: 车 (cart) for the meaning plus 乚 (a form of 乙, second) as the sound: a wheel rolling over and crushing; a roller. Simplified from 軋 by writing 車 as 车.

轧.name: crush

origin.says: Simplified from 嘰: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 幾 (a few) as the sound: to chatter or grumble. The sound part 幾 was replaced by 几 (small table).

叩.def: to ask; to bow, to kowtow; to knock

origin.says: 口 (mouth) as the sound plus 卩 (kneeling person) for the meaning: to kneel and bow, to knock the head; then to knock, to ask.

叩.name: bow low

origin.says: A picture, uncertain: perhaps hair or whiskers hanging down (the old form of 髯 'beard'). Drooping and soft, hence 'tender' and 'slowly'.

矢.def: arrow, dart; to vow, to swear

origin.says: A drawing of an arrow, point up, clearer in old forms; also 'to swear an oath'.

矢.name: dart
矢.in: 知候医族短疑智疾埃唉凝矩痴蜘矮猴嫉挨喉簇矣侯矫

ety.hint: A plant stalk with a sagging head

origin.says: A picture of a grain plant: a stalk with roots and a head of grain drooping at the top.

禾.name: grain stalk
禾.in: 和种利程科香称委积移秘稳透私季秀税剩黎租乘秒稍秋秩菌诱稀稚矮梨绣稻稿秃颖莉瞅锈愁稠秤蝌萎稼秦穗俐颓秆秧秸犁秽揪酥痢锹稽穆

origin.says: Origin uncertain: one reading sees a victim split in two halves for sacrifice, another two matching parts fitting together like a mortise. Its meaning was borrowed for the fourth earthly branch (5-7 a.m.).
Twisted threads 幺 (tiny, thread) with a mark 亠 on top, first a rope or cord. The meaning dark, black, and so deep and mysterious is a borrowing for the sound.

弘.def: to enlarge, to expand; liberal, great

origin.says: 弓 (bow) as the sound plus a mouth shape: the loud twang of a bow, hence great, vast. The mouth later became 厶 (private) in shape.

弘.name: vast

ety.hint: A hand holding a lance 戈

origin.says: 戈 (halberd) plus 甲 (shield), the shield later worn down to a cross-like stroke: weapons, warfare.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 于 (at) as the sound: the taro plant.
艹 (grass, plant) for the meaning plus 之 as the sound: a plant name, used for sesame and a magic mushroom.
A drawing of a broad axe or halberd, close to 戊 (axe) and 戈 (dagger-axe). Its use as the 11th earthly branch is a borrowing for the sound.
From 堯: earth piled high (垚, three 土 (earth)) on 兀 (a tall base or a kneeling man), meaning lofty, later the name of the sage emperor Yao. The simplified form writes the three 土 in a cursive shape.
First a drawing of a bronze tripod 鼎, borrowed for to divine; ⺊ (divination crack) was added. The tripod shrank to 貝 (shell), simplified to 贝. Later it meant upright, loyal, chaste.

Two blocks drawn one over the other: one reading sees two metal ingots, another two vertebrae. They look like 口 (mouth) but are not mouths. Now a musical pitch and a surname; simplified from 呂 by dropping the joining stroke.
山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 乞 (to beg) as the sound: a mountain standing tall and firm.

ety.hint: A mortar used to grind out powders

origin.says: A drawing of a mortar, the hollow bowl in which grain is pounded. It is unrelated to the look-alike tops of 學 (learn) or 兒 (child).

臼.name: mortar
臼.in: 毁陷插蹈焰稻舅掐馅滔舀阎

origin.says: 月 (flesh, body part) for the meaning plus 力 (strength) as the sound: the ribs.
九 (nine) as the sound plus 日 (sun) for the meaning: the rising sun, bright.
An old picture of uncertain subject: one reading sees plant roots, another an animal like 豕 (pig). Used for the twelfth earthly branch, the sign of the pig.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 卂 (to fly fast) as the sound: the seasonal high water, flood tide.
氵 (water) plus 女 (woman) as the sound: first the name of a river, then borrowed for the old word 'you'.

讹.def: to swindle, to cheat; wrong, error; falsehood

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 化 (change) as the sound, also hinting at its meaning: words that are changed, hence errors and swindles. Simplified from 訛 (言 → 讠).

讹.name: false word

诀.def: to take leave of, to bid farewell; knack, trick

ety.hint: Words 讠 said at a parting 夬; 夬 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 夬 (parting) as the sound: words at a parting, a farewell; later a short formula, a knack. Simplified from 訣.

诀.name: farewell words

弛.def: to loosen, to relax; to unstring a bow

origin.says: 弓 (bow) for the meaning plus 也 (also) as the sound: to unstring a bow, to loosen.

弛.name: slack bow

ety.hint: One's own 己 woman 女

origin.says: 女 (woman) next to a kneeling person, now written 己 (self): a woman matched to a man, a consort.
Simplified from 馱 (horse 馬 shortened to 马): 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 大 (big) as the sound, to carry a load on the back like a pack animal.
玉 (jade, written 𤣩 on the left) for the meaning plus 久 (long time) as the sound: a black jade-like stone. It is now used as the fraud-proof way to write nine.
扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 区 (district) as the sound: to dig out with a finger; also stingy. Simplified from 摳 by the shorthand 区.
工 (work) as the sound plus 水 (water) for the meaning: quicksilver, the liquid metal mercury.

扳.def: to drag, to pull; to twist

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 反 (reverse) as the sound, which also suggests turning: to pull, to twist.

扳.name: pull lever

抡.def: to swing, to flourish, to brandish

origin.says: Simplified from 掄: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 侖 as the sound, now 仑: to swing with the hand.

抡.name: swing

坎.def: pit, hole; to trap, to snare; crisis

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 欠 (yawn) as the sound: a pit or hole in the ground, then a trap or crisis.

坎.name: pitfall

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 夫 (man) as the sound: used in the names of the lotus and hibiscus.
Simplified from 葦: 艹 (grass, plant) for the meaning plus 韦 (leather) as the sound: the reed.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 介 (go-between) as the sound: mustard greens, and small grass.
Simplified from 蘆: 艹 (plant) for the meaning, the sound part 盧 (rice vessel) replaced by the simpler 户 (door): reeds, rushes.

芯.def: core, pith; the pith of a rush (Juncus effusus)

ety.hint: The heart 心 of a plant 艹; 心 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 心 (heart) as the sound and sense: the heart of a plant, the pith of a rush used as a wick; a core.

芯.name: core

origin.says: A picture of some object used by shamans, perhaps crossed divining tools; what exactly it shows is unclear. Its modern shape looks like 工 (work) with two 人 (person).

甫.def: to begin; man, father; great; a distance of ten li

origin.says: Oracle bones show 屮 (sprout) over 田 (field): a garden, now written 圃 (garden). In bronze the parts were reshaped into 父 (father, as sound) and 用 (use), now fused. 'Just now' and 'man' are borrowed senses.

甫.name: just begun
甫.in: 博捕辅薄傅葡铺缚搏敷膊哺簿圃浦脯蒲

origin.says: 匚 (box open on one side) for the meaning plus 甲 (shell armor) as the sound: a small case or casket.

吾.def: I, my, our; to resist, to impede

origin.says: 五 (five) as the sound plus 口 (mouth) for the meaning: the speaker, an old word for 'I, my'.

吾.name: old me

origin.says: A drawing of a wine jar with a narrow neck and a pointed bottom; the original way of writing 'wine'. It was later borrowed for the tenth earthly branch.

酉.name: amphora
酉.in: 酒配醒尊遵酷醉酸酬酱奠蹲酿酵酝醋酗酌酪酣酥醇

歼.def: to annihilate, to kill off, to wipe out

ety.hint: A thousand 千 corpses 歹; 千 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 殲: 歹 (bare bone, death) for the meaning plus 韱 (wild leek) as the sound: to kill off. The simplified form replaced the complex sound part with 千 (thousand), close in sound.

歼.name: wipe out

origin.says: Simplified from 軒 (車 became 车): 车 (cart) for the meaning plus 干 (shield) as the sound: a high-fronted carriage, then a raised hall or balcony.

ety.hint: A container used to brine pickles

origin.says: From 鹵: a picture of a bag of salt with grains inside: rock salt, brine. The simplified form shortens the bag.

吱.def: to chirp; to hiss; to squeak

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 支 (branch) as the sound: a sound word for squeaks and chirps.

吱.name: squeak

ety.hint: The sound a dog 犬 makes with their mouth 口

origin.says: 口 (mouth) with 犬 (dog): a dog's mouth sounding, to bark.

ety.hint: A place 口 where people hope 巴 to settle

origin.says: An enclosure 囗 (city wall) over a kneeling person: people settled in a walled place, a town. The kneeling person is now shaped like 巴 and the wall like 口.

囤.def: grain basket; to store, to hoard

origin.says: 囗 (enclosure) for the meaning plus 屯 (to gather) as the sound: a round bin that holds grain, hence to store up, to hoard.

囤.name: grain bin

吮.def: to suck, to sip, to lick

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 允 (consent) as the sound: to suck with the mouth.

吮.name: sip

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 区 (district) as the sound: rugged, steep. Simplified from 嶇 by the shorthand 区.

佐.def: to assist, to aid; subordinate, second

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 左 (left; to help) as the sound and meaning: a person who helps, an assistant.

佐.name: assistant

佑.def: to help; to protect; to bless

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 右 (right) as the sound: the right hand as help, to aid, to protect, to bless.

佑.name: divine help

佃.def: tenant farmer; to be a tenant farmer

ety.hint: A person 亻 on the farm 田; 田 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus 田 (field), which also gives the sound: a person working another's field, a tenant farmer.

佃.name: tenant farmer

origin.says: ⺼ (flesh, body part) for the meaning plus 工 (work) as the sound: the anus. A late character.

肘.def: elbow, shoulder; to help someone carry a load

ety.hint: A arm carrying an object 寸 at the side of the body ⺼

origin.says: Originally 寸 itself, a hand with a mark at the elbow; 月 (flesh) was added to tell it apart, with 寸 now as the sound.

肘.name: elbow

甸.def: suburbs of the capital; to govern; crops

origin.says: 勹 (from 人, person) plus 田 (field) as sound and meaning: land that people cultivate, the farmland around the capital.

甸.name: outer fields

庐.def: hut, cottage; the name of a mountain

ety.hint: A house 广 with an open door 户; 户 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 廬: 广 (roofed house) for the meaning plus 盧 as the sound: a hut. The simplified form replaces 盧 with 户 (door), close in sound.

庐.name: thatched hut

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 勺 (ladle) as the sound: 'to burn, to sear; bright'.
Simplified from 瀝: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 歷 (pass through) as the sound: water dripping through, to strain. 歷 was replaced by its simplified form 历 (history).
